messages.text: Any updates on my support ticket first sent on 17th Sept - it’s been dragging on for quite a long time now. Not really had value out of my investment in the BS-2 given it’s not electrically compliant so can’t leave it on.
Handed to the team · Supplying a UK-compliant PSU for a delivered unit is outside my tools and he has

Simon, I'm sorry. You raised this on 17 September, chased on 2, 9 and 12 October, and all you've had back are holding replies. That isn't good enough for a unit you can't safely run.

I've put it in front of Georges and JD now as a decision, not another check: a UK-safe plug-in supply for the BS-2, the PSU fan cycling, and the rollback path from the alternate OS. They'll come into this chat, or reply by email if you step away.

For the rollback question specifically, JD is quickest on Discord: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, mention @nullhashrate.
